title: Roadmap
intro_md: What we're working on and what's next. No dates, since things ship when their reviews and checks pass.

items.title: A screensaver preview
items.detail_md: My pull request [#308](https://github.com/pwnedbygary/phobos/pull/308): a Preview row in the app's Settings and a Show Screensaver hotkey, Back + Start by default, to see the screensaver without waiting for its delay.

items.title: Automatic handover for the GE thread
items.detail_md: An Auto mode that hands over both ways, keeping a game synchronous where the two threads would only take turns.

items.title: Live switching for the PSP
items.detail_md: Changing the PSP's resolution and renderer mid-game, with no restart. The GE work it was waiting on has merged now.

items.title: Vulkan (accurate), faster
items.detail_md: Getting the accurate Vulkan renderer closer to the fast one's speed on the handheld.
